correctness.rationale: The precise labelled graph and tie-retaining synchronous majority rule reduce the claim to a finite 2048-element map. Two separately implemented complete enumerators (path-following and indegree pruning with independently entered edges) agree on all eleven nonempty depth/period cells, all 57 basin sizes, sharp period-by-seven identities and 30 last-layer consensus states; dihedral and complement invariances are checked exhaustively. The scripts are fully included, replayable and do not rely on sample statistics.

value.rationale: The 11-vertex Grötzsch/Mycielski pentagon graph is a canonical minimal triangle-free four-chromatic network. A full exact basin partition and sharp relaxation clock provide a natural benchmark for majority dynamics on high-chromatic triangle-free graphs, exposing nontrivial coexistence of 57 attractors with consensus mass 221/256 and a last-depth layer that feeds only consensus. No unsupported large-family generalization is claimed.
